title: Eloqua Plus Folloze: Enterprise ABM Landing Pages That Launch Faster and Perform Better
theme: Eloqua + Folloze for Enterprise ABM Landing Pages
thesis: Eloqua plus Folloze lets enterprise marketers launch personalized ABM landing pages 50% faster without web-dev bottlenecks. The integration sends Eloqua segment data into Folloze for dynamic content, then returns individual-level engagement data for scoring and attribution. One marketer can run programs that used to require a team.
summary: You have the target accounts. You have the Eloqua programs. But every time you need a personalized landing page for an ABM campaign, you wait days or weeks for the web team. By the time the page goes live, the buyer has already moved on. Pipeline anxiety builds. Credibility with sales erodes. Generic outreach fails because the experience does not match the promise.
key_takeaways: TL;DR: Eloqua plus Folloze lets enterprise marketers launch personalized ABM landing pages 50% faster without web-dev bottlenecks.

Eloqua plus Folloze means connecting Eloqua's marketing automation strength with Folloze's AI orchestration platform to create dynamic, personalized ABM landing pages that launch fast, engage buying groups at the indi.
It turns Eloqua segments into live, personalized landing page experiences without custom development.
Set up the connector once, then build campaigns in a repeatable workflow.
